description.zh: 把值得反复听的声音，变成可以慢慢读的文字；持续整理科技、创业与 AI 播客。
description.en: Turns podcasts, long videos, and audio sources into readable transcripts and publishable long-form outputs for archival reading.

quickPrompts.zh: 把这期音频转成可读逐字稿，并保留说话人和时间线
quickPrompts.en: Turn this audio into a readable transcript with speakers and timestamps.

quickPrompts.zh: 先判断输入来源是否可直接处理，再说明缺什么
quickPrompts.en: Check the source first, then tell me whether it can be processed and what is missing.

quickPrompts.zh: 基于逐字稿继续生成适合网页、PDF 和 EPUB 的版本
quickPrompts.en: From the transcript, generate versions for web, PDF, and EPUB.

description.zh: 将用户出生信息转换为可复用的紫微斗数人生报告生成流程，报告表达避免术语堆砌、宿命化、鸡汤化和具体事件臆测。
description.en: Creates a practical Zi Wei life report from normalized birth data, solar-time correction, chart generation, and clear narrative analysis.

quickPrompts.zh: 根据我的出生信息生成一份紫微斗数人生报告
quickPrompts.en: Create a Zi Wei life report from my birth details.

quickPrompts.zh: 先帮我校正真太阳时并生成星盘
quickPrompts.en: Correct my solar time and generate the birth chart first.

quickPrompts.zh: 生成适合分享的 HTML 报告和长图
quickPrompts.en: Generate a shareable HTML report and long image.
